note: 2026-11-12, SECURITY-HARDENING-AUDIT lane 2. No read-only path exists: scripts/ops/cloud_open_port.py and oci_console_ingress.py both WRITE ingress rules. The sandbox cannot probe from outside (it blocks non-HTTPS egress; port 22 control failed). Output only ports and whether the source is 0.0.0.0/0 or private; mask other CIDRs. Close test: one run lists the rules and says, for each of 22/80/443/8001/2019/111/4002, open-to-world yes/no.
